artworks.title: The Daughter of Men Becomes a Siren
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch featuring multiple human figures. The sketch shows full-length body depictions of two standing figures and one figure lying down. The standing figures are drawn with arms raised, one on the left and one centrally placed. The left figure appears as if floating or in motion, with markings on the body, potentially scales or texture, and has a curly hairstyle. The central standing figure has a slight tilt suggesting movement or dance. The facial features are not detailed but imply an upward gaze. Both figures appear unclothed, their forms suggested with light lines. The lying figure is depicted in a reclined position. The background is plain and unmarked, emphasizing the sketched figures without distraction. No jewelry or objects are distinguished in the drawing. The artwork has a rough, ethereal quality typical of a preliminary sketch.

artworks.title: Enoch before the Great Glory
artworks.description: The image features softly drawn geometric shapes and flowing lines forming an abstract composition. There are circles and curved lines, with a central figure surrounded by three smaller humanoid figures. The arrangement could be interpreted as a central figure seated on a throne, attended by the smaller figures around it. The shapes suggest faces and drapery, contributing to the ghostly and mystical appearance, blending with the abstract nature of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Vision of the Lord of Spirits
artworks.description: The sketch depicts several figures in various poses. The central figure is standing upright, flanked by other figures. The central figure's facial features are softly outlined with a focus on the eyes, and there are wavy indications of hair. The clothing is not explicitly detailed, giving the impression of a nude form with sketchy lines suggesting motion or drapery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. Surrounding the central figure are other human forms in different poses. The background has light pencil markings, and handwritten notes are present at the top and bottom of the sketch.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Lucas Emil Vorsterman
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from the waist up. The central figure is seated with shoulders exposed, head slightly tilted and downward, wearing a crown of thorns, with light radiating behind their head. He has curly hair and a beard, with a somber facial expression. The figure on the left is looking up at the central figure, with curly hair and facial hair, wearing layered garments and a cloak. A third figure is slightly behind them, wearing a helmet. Both figures on the left hold wooden staffs. The background is dark, and there's Latin text along the bottom edge of the image.

artworks.title: Titian and His Mistress
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Titian
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring an elderly man and a woman. The man is on the left, touching the woman's shoulder. He has a long beard, a cap, and wrinkles. The woman has wavy hair, wearing a dress with a fur collar. The background is dark with a human skull placed on a shelf in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Peasant Filling a Glass
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing and pouring liquid from a jug into a glass. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, red shirt, green vest, yellow pants tucked into purple hose, and brown shoes.

artworks.title: Peasant Smoking
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a wooden bench. The person is leaning forward and their facial features include a nose and a beard. They are wearing a red cap under a large black hat, a brown vest over a purple shirt, a brown belt, yellowish pants, and holding a long-stemmed pipe. Beside them on the bench is a tanned jug. The background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with Orpheus and the Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collection of classical figures and mythological motifs. It features detailed scenes and decorative elements including medallions of mythological activities, scrollwork, intertwined figures, winged beings, and classical deities engaged in various actions. The drawing is rich in classical iconography and arranged in a harmonious and orderly manner reminiscent of Renaissance artwork.

artworks.title: Sibylla Persica
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with relaxed posture, wearing classic garments, holding a book. They have curly hair with a decorative band, looking serene. Background displays clouds and rays of light.

artworks.title: Sibylla Agrippa
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person wearing a classical-style robe. The individual has delicate facial features, prominent eyes, and short curled hair. The clothing includes a draped garment with patterned sleeves and textures. The person is holding a rectangular block with one hand, on which a branch with leaves rests. A simple necklace is visible around the neckline. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sibylla Phrygia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her body slightly turned to the side while facing the viewer. She has a serene expression and long, wavy hair flowing from under a veil. The woman wears a long gown, holds a rod-like object in one hand, and rests the other hand on her lap. She wears a necklace with rounded elements around her neck. In the background, there is a large column and leafy plants near her feet.

artworks.title: Sibylla Samia
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a chair. The person is in a relaxed position, with the upper body slightly turned to the side and the head tilting upwards. The facial features are delicately drawn, with the eyes looking upward and the lips closed. The hair is styled in tight curls that frame the face. The individual is dressed in a flowing, intricately patterned gown with long sleeves, holding a small sheaf of wheat in one hand, while the other hand rests on the side of the chair. The person is also wearing a necklace with a circular pendant. The background features a column to the left and some vegetation at the base of the chair. The ground texture appears uneven.

artworks.title: Sibylla Europa
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the thighs up, seated and slightly turned to the right. The face has soft features, full lips, and a direct gaze. The person has short, curly hair with a leafy band, wearing an intricately detailed robe with flowing sleeves and holding a sword in the right hand and a branch in the left hand. The background is plain with a hint of foliage to the right of the figure.

artworks.title: Sibylla Hellespontina
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on a stone-like structure. The person is upright with one knee bent and raised, holding a branch with leaves in one hand and the other hand resting on their knee. The individual's facial features suggest age, with an intent gaze. They wear a head covering that drapes over their shoulders, a long robe with folds and patterns, and simple footwear. In the background is a stone column, scattered stones, and plant elements. Simple lines and shadows provide texture to the illustration.

artworks.title: Sibylla Erythraea
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a lamb in her lap. She has a headscarf, robe, and sandals. She is holding the lamb against her chest, with foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Sibylla Cimmeria
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a three-quarter view, looking left. They have a serene expression with detailed facial features and styled hair. The person wears flowing robes and holds a bouquet of flowers. In the background, there is an architectural element to the right and a cloud with emanating rays to the left. The image is rendered with fine line work.

artworks.title: Sibylla Delphica
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting at an angle and looking over her shoulder. Her hair is braided, and she is wearing a flowing garment, a necklace, and a draped cloak or fabric over one shoulder. She holds a book in her left hand and a crown of thorns in her right hand. She is seated on a block or structure with architectural elements, and the background has simple lined patterns.

artworks.title: Sibylla Cumana
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body side profile of a seated person holding an open book with both hands. The person has curly hair styled in a bun, delicate facial features, and is wearing a robe with long sleeves and a belt. They also hold a staff with a cross and a banner attached, billowing in the background.

artworks.title: Sibylla Tiburtina
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a stone bench, holding a bowl and a palm frond. She has distinct facial features with a serene expression, arched eyebrows, and a gentle smile. Her hair is styled with curls and covered by a veil, and she wears a necklace and a single pearl earring. She is dressed in a draped gown with a cinched waist and layered details. The background features architectural elements including columns and a curved arch. A small plant-like design is in the bottom left corner. There are inscriptions in the upper left-hand corner.

artworks.title: Sibylla Libyca
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated, holding a book and a leafy branch. They wear a cloth headpiece and a flowing robe. Their eyes are closed and they have a serene expression. Foliage is visible in the background. A decorative wheel-like object is on the ground nearby. The illustration features detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one hand raised and the other hand holding a staff with a flag attached to it. The person is positioned on a slight diagonal, with one foot slightly in front of the other. The individual has a beard, long hair, and is wearing a robe with detailed drapery and decoration around the neckline. A halo surrounds the person's head with radiant rays extending outward. The background is plain with no additional objects or details, focusing solely on the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a full-body illustration. The person has long, curly hair, a full beard, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. They are wearing a flowing robe with long sleeves, and their feet are bare. The person is holding a staff and has a halo around their head. The background is plain, with slight texturing of the canvas visible. At the bottom, there is text that reads, "San Mathias Apostolus."

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing upright. The individual is holding a long staff in their right hand while resting their left arm on a scroll. They have long, wavy hair and a full beard that flows down over their chest. The person has a halo around their head. They are clothed in a draped garment that falls to their feet, with detailed folds and textures. The art is on a plain background, and at the bottom, text reads "S PAVLVS APOSTOLUS," identifying the person as Saint Paul.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding a large cross, standing with an inclined posture. He has long hair, a bushy beard, and is dressed in robes. A halo surrounds his head. The background is plain, with minimal details. The text "S. Philippus Apostolus" is written below the figure.
